title: Can You Afford to Quit Your Job? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Burnt out at work and dreaming of a career change? Before you take the leap, you need a financial game plan — and Jill and Mark are here to help you get there. This week, they're helping caller Sarah figure out whether her family can afford for her husband to walk away from a lucrative but unfulfilling career.
